faq.q: What is the origin of Ahmed?
faq.a: Ahmed is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of أحمد.
Yes — the underlying form أحمد is Arabic.
Ahmed can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ahmed should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. أحمد occurs in the Qur'an (Sūrat al-Ṣaff 61:6) as a name of the Prophet
